app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.Y29sdW1.source:
The type of each column whose type is given rather than inferred from the first rows (see `type_sample_rows`), by column name: `string`, `int`, `float`, `number`, `bool`, `date`, or `any`.

Values are converted to the column's type: `string` converts numbers, booleans and dates to text (for example identifiers stored as numbers); `int` accepts numbers without a fraction; `float` and `number` accept numbers; `bool` accepts booleans; `date` accepts dates; `any` returns every value as stored.  A value that the type does not accept raises `EXCEL-COLUMN-TYPE-ERROR`.  A column that is not a column of the worksheet, or an unknown type, raises `EXCEL-READ-OPTION-ERROR`.  Columns are only typed when the worksheet has headers.
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.Y29sdW1.message:

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.ZXJyb3J.source: How cells with an error such as #DIV/0! or #N/A are read
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.ZXJyb3J.message: 如何讀取含有 #DIV/0! 或 #N/A 等錯誤的儲存格

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.ZXJyb3J.source:
How cells with an error, such as `#DIV/0!`, `#N/A` or `#VALUE!`, and formulas whose result is an error are read:

- `fail` (the default): the read fails with `EXCEL-CELL-ERROR`, naming the worksheet, cell, column and error, unless `error_field` is set
- `null`: the cell has no value
- `text`: the cell's value is the error's text, such as `#DIV/0!`, in any column

With `error_field`, the errors of each record are also returned in a field of their own, and error cells are read as no value unless this option is `text`.
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.ZXJyb3J.message:
如何讀取含有錯誤（例如 `#DIV/0!`、`#N/A` 或 `#VALUE!`）的儲存格，以及結果為錯誤的公式：

- `fail`（預設值）：除非設定了 `error_field`，否則讀取會以 `EXCEL-CELL-ERROR` 失敗，並指出工作表、儲存格、欄和錯誤
- `null`：儲存格沒有值
- `text`：在任何欄中，儲存格的值都是錯誤的文字，例如 `#DIV/0!`

使用 `error_field` 時，每筆記錄的錯誤也會在其專屬欄位中傳回，而且除非此選項為 `text`，否則錯誤儲存格會讀取為無值。

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.ZXJyb3J.source: The name of an extra field added to every record with the errors of the row's cells: a hash of the error text (such as `#DIV/0!`) by column name, or `NOTHING` if none of the record's cells is an error. The name must not be the name of a column of the worksheet or of the `formula_field`; a name that is raises `EXCEL-READ-OPTION-ERROR`.
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.ZXJyb3J.message: 新增至每筆記錄、包含該列儲存格錯誤的額外欄位名稱：以欄名稱為鍵的錯誤文字（例如 `#DIV/0!`）雜湊；若記錄的儲存格都不是錯誤，則為 `NOTHING`。  此時會接受錯誤儲存格：它們會讀取為無值，或在 `error_cells` 為 `text` 時讀取為其文字。  名稱不得為工作表欄的名稱或 `formula_field`；此類名稱會引發 `EXCEL-READ-OPTION-ERROR`。

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.Zm9ybXV.source: Return the formulas of each row's cells in a field with this name
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.Zm9ybXV.message: 在此名稱的欄位中傳回每一列儲存格的公式

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.Zm9ybXV.source:
The name of an extra field added to every record with the formulas of the row's cells, so the process reading the file can tell rows calculated by formulas from rows of data.  The most common use is recognizing a **totals row made only of `SUM` formulas**, with no `Total` label, at run time in the same way as the spreadsheet profile does at design time: pass the field's value to `DataProvider::TabularProfiler::hasTotalsFormula()`.

**Value:** a hash of the formula text (as Excel shows it, without the leading `=`) by the cell's reference in the worksheet (for example `{"B5": "SUM(B2:B4)"}`), with one entry for each cell of the record that holds a formula; `NOTHING` if none of the record's cells holds a formula.  References are those of the worksheet, whatever the `data_cells` range.

Values of formula cells are still returned as their calculated results.  The name must not be the name of a column of the worksheet; a name that is raises `EXCEL-FORMULA-FIELD-ERROR`.  If not set, records have no formula field and formulas are not read.
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.Zm9ybXV.message:
加入每筆記錄、包含該列儲存格公式的額外欄位名稱，讓讀取檔案的處理程序能區分由公式計算的列與資料列。最常見的用途是在執行階段以與設計階段試算表剖析相同的方式，辨識**僅由 `SUM` 公式組成的總計列**（沒有 `Total` 標籤）：將欄位值傳給 `DataProvider::TabularProfiler::hasTotalsFormula()`。

**值：**以工作表中儲存格參照為鍵的公式文字（如 Excel 所顯示，不含開頭的 `=`）雜湊（例如 `{"B5": "SUM(B2:B4)"}`），記錄中每個含有公式的儲存格各有一個項目；若記錄的儲存格都不含公式則為 `NOTHING`。不論 `data_cells` 範圍為何，參照都是工作表的參照。

公式儲存格的值仍會以其計算結果傳回。名稱不得為工作表欄的名稱；此類名稱會引發 `EXCEL-FORMULA-FIELD-ERROR`。若未設定，記錄沒有公式欄位，也不會讀取公式。

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.dHlwZV9.source:
The number of data rows read to infer the type of each column from its values; `0` reads every value as stored, with columns of any type.

A column whose values in these rows are all whole numbers is an `int` column, numbers a `float` column, booleans a `bool` column, dates a `date` column, and text a `string` column; a column with values of different kinds, or with no values, is returned as stored (`any`).  Empty cells and error cells are not counted.  The types are those of the spreadsheet profile.  A later value that its column's type does not accept raises `EXCEL-COLUMN-TYPE-ERROR`, which names the remedies: giving the column's type with `column_types`, or sampling more rows.  Columns are only typed when the worksheet has headers.
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.dHlwZV9.message:
為從值推斷每一欄類型而讀取的資料列數；`0` 會依儲存方式讀取每個值，欄可為任何類型。

在這些列中值全為整數的欄為 `int` 欄，數字為 `float` 欄，布林值為 `bool` 欄，日期為 `date` 欄，文字為 `string` 欄；含有不同種類的值或沒有值的欄，會依儲存方式傳回（`any`）。  空白儲存格和錯誤儲存格不列入計算。  類型即試算表剖析的類型。  其欄類型不接受的後續值會引發 `EXCEL-COLUMN-TYPE-ERROR`，並指出補救方式：使用 `column_types` 指定欄的類型，或取樣更多列。  只有在工作表有標題時，欄才會有類型。

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.d29ya3N.source: A regular expression that the name of exactly one worksheet must match, for files whose worksheet name changes from file to file, such as `Jan 2026` and `Feb 2026`: use `^\w+ \d{4}$`, or `(?i)^export` to match without regard to case; the pattern is searched in the name, so anchor it with `^` and `$` to match the whole name.  No match raises `EXCEL-WORKSHEET-NOT-FOUND` and more than one match raises `EXCEL-WORKSHEET-AMBIGUOUS`, both listing the worksheets of the file; conflicts with `worksheet`
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZA.option.d29ya3N.message: 工作表名稱必須恰好符合一個工作表的正規表示式，適用於工作表名稱隨檔案改變的檔案，例如 `Jan 2026` 與 `Feb 2026`：使用 `^\w+ \d{4}$`，或使用 `(?i)^export` 以不區分大小寫比對；模式會在名稱中搜尋，因此請以 `^` 與 `$` 錨定以比對整個名稱。沒有符合時會引發 `EXCEL-WORKSHEET-NOT-FOUND`，有多個符合時會引發 `EXCEL-WORKSHEET-AMBIGUOUS`，兩者都會列出檔案的工作表；與 `worksheet` 衝突

app.RXhjZWw.action.cHJvZmlsZQ.short_desc.source: Describe the layout and columns of every sheet of an Excel spreadsheet
app.RXhjZWw.action.cHJvZmlsZQ.short_desc.message: 描述 Excel 試算表每個工作表的版面配置與欄位

app.RXhjZWw.action.cHJvZmlsZQ.desc.source:
Describes how every sheet of an Excel spreadsheet (`.xlsx` or `.xls`) is laid out, so it can be read correctly before an integration is built around it.

**Detects:**
- hidden sheets, named ranges, merged cells, and formulas
- the header row, title rows and banners above it, and the data region
- totals and subtotal rows and blank-row gaps
- each column's type with a confidence and counter-examples
- dates and numbers stored as text in a local format, and identifiers with leading zeros

Sample values are redacted to their shape by default (`redact`), so a profile can be shared without the data itself.
app.RXhjZWw.action.cHJvZmlsZQ.desc.message:
描述 Excel 試算表 (`.xlsx` 或 `.xls`) 中每個工作表的版面配置，以便在圍繞其建立整合之前能正確讀取。

**偵測內容：**
- 隱藏的工作表、具名範圍、合併儲存格與公式
- 標題列、其上方的標題文字列與橫幅，以及資料區域
- 合計列與小計列，以及空白列的間隔
- 每個欄位的類型，附信賴度與反例
- 以本地格式儲存為文字的日期與數字，以及帶有前導零的識別碼

範例值預設會遮蔽為其形狀 (`redact`)，因此可以在不包含資料本身的情況下分享分析結果。

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Z.source: How cells with an error such as #DIV/0! or #N/A are read
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Z.message: 如何讀取含有 #DIV/0! 或 #N/A 等錯誤的儲存格

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Z.source:
How cells with an error, such as `#DIV/0!`, `#N/A` or `#VALUE!`, and formulas whose result is an error are read:

- `fail` (the default): the read fails with `EXCEL-CELL-ERROR`, naming the worksheet, cell, column and error, unless `error_field` is set
- `null`: the cell has no value
- `text`: the cell's value is the error's text, such as `#DIV/0!`, in any column

With `error_field`, the errors of each record are also returned in a field of their own, and error cells are read as no value unless this option is `text`.
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Z.message:
如何讀取含有錯誤（例如 `#DIV/0!`、`#N/A` 或 `#VALUE!`）的儲存格，以及結果為錯誤的公式：

- `fail`（預設值）：除非設定了 `error_field`，否則讀取會以 `EXCEL-CELL-ERROR` 失敗，並指出工作表、儲存格、欄和錯誤
- `null`：儲存格沒有值
- `text`：在任何欄中，儲存格的值都是錯誤的文字，例如 `#DIV/0!`

使用 `error_field` 時，每筆記錄的錯誤也會在其專屬欄位中傳回，而且除非此選項為 `text`，否則錯誤儲存格會讀取為無值。

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Z.source: Formula Field
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Z.message: 公式欄位

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Z.source: Return the formulas of each row's cells in a field with this name
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Z.message: 在此名稱的欄位中傳回每一列儲存格的公式

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Z.source:
The name of an extra field added to every record with the formulas of the row's cells, so the process reading the file can tell rows calculated by formulas from rows of data.  The most common use is recognizing a **totals row made only of `SUM` formulas**, with no `Total` label, at run time in the same way as the spreadsheet profile does at design time: pass the field's value to `DataProvider::TabularProfiler::hasTotalsFormula()`.

**Value:** a hash of the formula text (as Excel shows it, without the leading `=`) by the cell's reference in the worksheet (for example `{"B5": "SUM(B2:B4)"}`), with one entry for each cell of the record that holds a formula; `NOTHING` if none of the record's cells holds a formula.  References are those of the worksheet, whatever the `data_cells` range.

Values of formula cells are still returned as their calculated results.  The name must not be the name of a column of the worksheet; a name that is raises `EXCEL-FORMULA-FIELD-ERROR`.  If not set, records have no formula field and formulas are not read.
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Z.message:
加入每筆記錄、包含該列儲存格公式的額外欄位名稱，讓讀取檔案的處理程序能區分由公式計算的列與資料列。最常見的用途是在執行階段以與設計階段試算表剖析相同的方式，辨識**僅由 `SUM` 公式組成的總計列**（沒有 `Total` 標籤）：將欄位值傳給 `DataProvider::TabularProfiler::hasTotalsFormula()`。

**值：**以工作表中儲存格參照為鍵的公式文字（如 Excel 所顯示，不含開頭的 `=`）雜湊（例如 `{"B5": "SUM(B2:B4)"}`），記錄中每個含有公式的儲存格各有一個項目；若記錄的儲存格都不含公式則為 `NOTHING`。不論 `data_cells` 範圍為何，參照都是工作表的參照。

公式儲存格的值仍會以其計算結果傳回。名稱不得為工作表欄的名稱；此類名稱會引發 `EXCEL-FORMULA-FIELD-ERROR`。若未設定，記錄沒有公式欄位，也不會讀取公式。

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.d.source:
The number of data rows read to infer the type of each column from its values; `0` reads every value as stored, with columns of any type.

A column whose values in these rows are all whole numbers is an `int` column, numbers a `float` column, booleans a `bool` column, dates a `date` column, and text a `string` column; a column with values of different kinds, or with no values, is returned as stored (`any`).  Empty cells and error cells are not counted.  The types are those of the spreadsheet profile.  A later value that its column's type does not accept raises `EXCEL-COLUMN-TYPE-ERROR`, which names the remedies: giving the column's type with `column_types`, or sampling more rows.  Columns are only typed when the worksheet has headers.
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.d.message:
為從值推斷每一欄類型而讀取的資料列數；`0` 會依儲存方式讀取每個值，欄可為任何類型。

在這些列中值全為整數的欄為 `int` 欄，數字為 `float` 欄，布林值為 `bool` 欄，日期為 `date` 欄，文字為 `string` 欄；含有不同種類的值或沒有值的欄，會依儲存方式傳回（`any`）。  空白儲存格和錯誤儲存格不列入計算。  類型即試算表剖析的類型。  其欄類型不接受的後續值會引發 `EXCEL-COLUMN-TYPE-ERROR`，並指出補救方式：使用 `column_types` 指定欄的類型，或取樣更多列。  只有在工作表有標題時，欄才會有類型。

app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.d.source: A regular expression that the name of exactly one worksheet must match, for files whose worksheet name changes from file to file, such as `Jan 2026` and `Feb 2026`: use `^\w+ \d{4}$`, or `(?i)^export` to match without regard to case; the pattern is searched in the name, so anchor it with `^` and `$` to match the whole name.  No match raises `EXCEL-WORKSHEET-NOT-FOUND` and more than one match raises `EXCEL-WORKSHEET-AMBIGUOUS`, both listing the worksheets of the file; conflicts with `worksheet`
app.RXhjZWw.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.d.message: 工作表名稱必須恰好符合一個工作表的正規表示式，適用於工作表名稱隨檔案改變的檔案，例如 `Jan 2026` 與 `Feb 2026`：使用 `^\w+ \d{4}$`，或使用 `(?i)^export` 以不區分大小寫比對；模式會在名稱中搜尋，因此請以 `^` 與 `$` 錨定以比對整個名稱。沒有符合時會引發 `EXCEL-WORKSHEET-NOT-FOUND`，有多個符合時會引發 `EXCEL-WORKSHEET-AMBIGUOUS`，兩者都會列出檔案的工作表；與 `worksheet` 衝突

app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGU.option.Y29sdW.source:
The display format of columns by their header name, so that whoever opens the file sees each value as intended: a date as `dd.mm.yyyy`, an amount as `#,##0.00`, or a share as `0.0%`.  The cells keep their real values (a date stays a date and a number a number); only the way they are shown changes.  A column without a format is written as without this option: dates as `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` and numbers without a format.

Format codes are written as in Excel and LibreOffice:
- **numbers**: `0` (a digit that is always shown), `#` (a digit shown when significant), `,` between digits (thousands grouping), `,` after the last digit (divide by 1000), `.` (the decimal point), and `E+00` (scientific notation); up to three sections for positive, negative and zero values separated by `;`, such as `#,##0.00;(#,##0.00)` or `#,##0.00;#,##0.00-`
- **percentages**: a `%` in each section, such as `0.0%`; the value is a fraction, so `0.25` is shown as `25.0%`
- **dates and times**: `yy` or `yyyy` (year), `m`, `mm`, `mmm` or `mmmm` (month as a number or a name), `d` or `dd` (day), `ddd` or `dddd` (weekday name), `h` or `hh` (hour), `m` or `mm` directly after an hour or before a second (minute), `s` or `ss` (second), `.0` to `.000` after the second (fractions of a second), and `AM/PM`, such as `dd.mm.yyyy hh:mm`
- **text**: `@`

Text in a code is written in double quotes (`"EUR"`), escaped with a backslash (`\x`), as a currency symbol in brackets (`[$€-407]`), or as itself for `$ - + / ( ) :`, spaces and symbols such as `€`; a section can start with a color such as `[Red]`.

A value that its column's code does not show, such as a string in a number column, is written without the format.  An invalid or unsupported code (`General`, fractions, fill characters, conditions, or elapsed times), or a column that is not written, raises `EXCEL-WRITE-OPTION-ERROR` naming the column and the problem
app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGU.option.Y29sdW.message:
依標頭名稱指定的欄位顯示格式，讓開啟檔案的人都能依預期看到每個值：日期顯示為 `dd.mm.yyyy`、金額顯示為 `#,##0.00`，或比例顯示為 `0.0%`。儲存格會保留其實際值（日期仍為日期，數字仍為數字），只有顯示方式會改變。未指定格式的欄位會如同未使用此選項時一樣寫入：日期為 `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss`，數字則不套用格式。

格式代碼的寫法與 Excel 和 LibreOffice 相同：
- **數字**：`0`（一律顯示的位數）、`#`（有效時才顯示的位數）、位數之間的 `,`（千分位分組）、最後一位數之後的 `,`（除以 1000）、`.`（小數點）以及 `E+00`（科學記號）；正值、負值與零值最多可有三個以 `;` 分隔的區段，例如 `#,##0.00;(#,##0.00)` 或 `#,##0.00;#,##0.00-`
- **百分比**：每個區段中有一個 `%`，例如 `0.0%`；值為小數，因此 `0.25` 會顯示為 `25.0%`
- **日期與時間**：`yy` 或 `yyyy`（年）、`m`、`mm`、`mmm` 或 `mmmm`（以數字或名稱表示的月）、`d` 或 `dd`（日）、`ddd` 或 `dddd`（星期名稱）、`h` 或 `hh`（時）、緊接在時之後或秒之前的 `m` 或 `mm`（分）、`s` 或 `ss`（秒）、秒之後的 `.0` 至 `.000`（秒的小數部分），以及 `AM/PM`，例如 `dd.mm.yyyy hh:mm`
- **文字**：`@`

代碼中的文字可以雙引號括住（`"EUR"`）、以反斜線跳脫（`\x`）、寫成方括號中的貨幣符號（`[$€-407]`），而 `$ - + / ( ) :`、空格及 `€` 等符號則可直接書寫；區段可以用 `[Red]` 等色彩開頭。

欄位代碼無法顯示的值（例如數字欄位中的字串）會以不套用格式的方式寫入。無效或不支援的代碼（`General`、分數、填滿字元、條件或經過時間），或未寫入的欄位，會引發 `EXCEL-WRITE-OPTION-ERROR`，並指出該欄位與問題

app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGU.option.Y29sdW.source: The display format of each column as a mask, such as DD.MM.YYYY or #.##0,00 €
app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGU.option.Y29sdW.message: 以遮罩表示的各欄顯示格式，例如 DD.MM.YYYY 或 #.##0,00 €

app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGU.option.Y29sdW.source:
The display format of columns by column name as masks of the [ValueMask](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/ValueMask/html/index.html) module, the masks that CSV files and sheet contracts are read and written with: a date as `DD.MM.YYYY`, a time as `hh:mm AM`, an amount as `#.##0,00 €` or a share as `0.#%`.  Each mask becomes the display format code of its column (`DD.MM.YYYY` is `dd\.mm\.yyyy`, `#.##0,00 €` is `#,##0.00" €"`), so the cells keep their real values (a date stays a date and a number a number) and are shown as the mask describes, with these differences from text:
- the group separator and decimal mark are shown as the language of whoever opens the file uses them; the mask's separators only say whether digits are grouped and how many decimals are shown
- `Mon` shows the month name in the language of whoever opens the file
- a final `#` shows at most 10 decimals, and a whole number with the decimal mark after it (`12.`)

A mask without a display format raises `EXCEL-WRITE-OPTION-ERROR` naming the column and the reason: `ZZ` (a cell holds no UTC offset), `MON` (there is no upper-case month name), `sss` not directly after `SS.`, a minute that is not directly after an hour or before the seconds, and a numeric month that is.  A column cannot have both a mask and a format code in `column_formats`
app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGU.option.Y29sdW.message:
依欄名稱指定欄的顯示格式，使用 [ValueMask](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/ValueMask/html/index.html) 模組的遮罩，也就是讀寫 CSV 檔案與工作表合約所用的遮罩：日期如 `DD.MM.YYYY`、時間如 `hh:mm AM`、金額如 `#.##0,00 €`、比例如 `0.#%`。每個遮罩會成為該欄的顯示格式代碼（`DD.MM.YYYY` 為 `dd\.mm\.yyyy`，`#.##0,00 €` 為 `#,##0.00" €"`），因此儲存格保留其實際值（日期仍為日期，數字仍為數字），並依遮罩的描述顯示，與文字的差異如下：
- 分組分隔符號與小數點符號依開啟檔案者的語言慣例顯示；遮罩的分隔符號只決定數字是否分組及顯示幾位小數
- `Mon` 以開啟檔案者的語言顯示月份名稱
- 結尾的 `#` 最多顯示 10 位小數，整數則在後面加上小數點符號顯示（`12.`）

沒有顯示格式的遮罩會引發 `EXCEL-WRITE-OPTION-ERROR`，並指出欄位與原因：`ZZ`（儲存格不含 UTC 偏移）、`MON`（沒有大寫的月份名稱）、不緊接在 `SS.` 之後的 `sss`、不緊接在小時之後或秒之前的分鐘，以及位於該處的數字月份。一欄不可同時具有遮罩與 `column_formats` 中的格式代碼

- **數字**：`0`（一律顯示的位數）、`#`（有效時才顯示的位數）、位數之間的 `,`（千分位分組）、最後一位數之後的 `,`（除以 1000）、`.`（小數點）以及 `E+00`（科學記號）；正值、負值與零值最多可有三個以 `;` 分隔的區段，例如 `#,##0.00;(#,##0.00)` 或 `#,##0.00;#,##0.00-`
- **百分比**：每個區段中有一個 `%`，例如 `0.0%`；值為小數，因此 `0.25` 會顯示為 `25.0%`
- **日期與時間**：`yy` 或 `yyyy`（年）、`m`、`mm`、`mmm` 或 `mmmm`（以數字或名稱表示的月）、`d` 或 `dd`（日）、`ddd` 或 `dddd`（星期名稱）、`h` 或 `hh`（時）、緊接在時之後或秒之前的 `m` 或 `mm`（分）、`s` 或 `ss`（秒）、秒之後的 `.0` 至 `.000`（秒的小數部分），以及 `AM/PM`，例如 `dd.mm.yyyy hh:mm`
- **文字**：`@`

代碼中的文字可以雙引號括住（`"EUR"`）、以反斜線跳脫（`\x`）、寫成方括號中的貨幣符號（`[$€-407]`），而 `$ - + / ( ) :`、空格及 `€` 等符號則可直接書寫；區段可以用 `[Red]` 等色彩開頭。

欄位代碼無法顯示的值（例如數字欄位中的字串）會以不套用格式的方式寫入。無效或不支援的代碼（`General`、分數、填滿字元、條件或經過時間），或未寫入的欄位，會引發 `EXCEL-WRITE-OPTION-ERROR`，並指出該欄位與問題

app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGUtZGF0YQ.option.source: Column Masks
app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGUtZGF0YQ.option.message: 欄遮罩

app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGUtZGF0YQ.option.source: The display format of each column as a mask, such as DD.MM.YYYY or #.##0,00 €
app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGUtZGF0YQ.option.message: 以遮罩表示的各欄顯示格式，例如 DD.MM.YYYY 或 #.##0,00 €

app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGUtZGF0YQ.option.source:
The display format of columns by column name as masks of the [ValueMask](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/ValueMask/html/index.html) module, the masks that CSV files and sheet contracts are read and written with: a date as `DD.MM.YYYY`, a time as `hh:mm AM`, an amount as `#.##0,00 €` or a share as `0.#%`.  Each mask becomes the display format code of its column (`DD.MM.YYYY` is `dd\.mm\.yyyy`, `#.##0,00 €` is `#,##0.00" €"`), so the cells keep their real values (a date stays a date and a number a number) and are shown as the mask describes, with these differences from text:
- the group separator and decimal mark are shown as the language of whoever opens the file uses them; the mask's separators only say whether digits are grouped and how many decimals are shown
- `Mon` shows the month name in the language of whoever opens the file
- a final `#` shows at most 10 decimals, and a whole number with the decimal mark after it (`12.`)

A mask without a display format raises `EXCEL-WRITE-OPTION-ERROR` naming the column and the reason: `ZZ` (a cell holds no UTC offset), `MON` (there is no upper-case month name), `sss` not directly after `SS.`, a minute that is not directly after an hour or before the seconds, and a numeric month that is.  A column cannot have both a mask and a format code in `column_formats`
app.RXhjZWw.action.d3JpdGUtZGF0YQ.option.message:
依欄名稱指定欄的顯示格式，使用 [ValueMask](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/ValueMask/html/index.html) 模組的遮罩，也就是讀寫 CSV 檔案與工作表合約所用的遮罩：日期如 `DD.MM.YYYY`、時間如 `hh:mm AM`、金額如 `#.##0,00 €`、比例如 `0.#%`。每個遮罩會成為該欄的顯示格式代碼（`DD.MM.YYYY` 為 `dd\.mm\.yyyy`，`#.##0,00 €` 為 `#,##0.00" €"`），因此儲存格保留其實際值（日期仍為日期，數字仍為數字），並依遮罩的描述顯示，與文字的差異如下：
- 分組分隔符號與小數點符號依開啟檔案者的語言慣例顯示；遮罩的分隔符號只決定數字是否分組及顯示幾位小數
- `Mon` 以開啟檔案者的語言顯示月份名稱
- 結尾的 `#` 最多顯示 10 位小數，整數則在後面加上小數點符號顯示（`12.`）

沒有顯示格式的遮罩會引發 `EXCEL-WRITE-OPTION-ERROR`，並指出欄位與原因：`ZZ`（儲存格不含 UTC 偏移）、`MON`（沒有大寫的月份名稱）、不緊接在 `SS.` 之後的 `sss`、不緊接在小時之後或秒之前的分鐘，以及位於該處的數字月份。一欄不可同時具有遮罩與 `column_formats` 中的格式代碼
